mouth_anchor.notes: Approximate upper-lip baseline; all overlays pre-registered to 1086x1448 canvas

animation_notes.blink: Open -> Half -> Open (~150 ms); Closed temporarily disabled
animation_notes.mouth: Use output PCM audio amplitude with smoothing, shape inference is NOT phoneme detection
animation_notes.head: Whole-avatar neck-pivot seam fallback: idle +/-0.35 degrees, talking +/-0.5 degrees; smooth 700 ms transitions
animation_notes.breathing: Uniform 1.002-1.004 scale around the neck; vertical translation up to +/-2 logical pixels in the Flutter viewport

limitations: Graphic sample assets suitable for an MVP, not production-grade photoreal visemes or automated retopology
Base is inpainted in eye/mouth regions; render one eye and one mouth overlay above it
A truly flexible 3D/2.5D head turn requires additional facial artwork/mesh rigging

mouth_assets.notes: Render foundation above head and below all mouth states. Corrected PNGs retain full-canvas coordinates; do not render unprocessed v2 ZIP PNGs directly.
